name: Close Interaction
description: A tight crop combining part of a face with the product genuinely in use against it — a serum near a cheek, a fragrance near a collarbone, headphones over an ear — closer and more intimate than a standard headshot portrait. Each of the 6 frames uses a genuinely different body zone, crop and angle, not six near-identical close-ups.
lighting: Soft close beauty light, true skin luminosity
subject: person
prompt: an extreme close crop combining part of a face — cheek, jaw, collarbone, or temple depending on how the product is actually used — with the product held or worn genuinely against the skin in natural real-world use, soft close beauty-style lighting giving true luminous skin rendering with a real soft catchlight, genuine visible skin texture at close range — real pore structure, fine natural asymmetry, faint peach-fuzz catching the light — never smoothed into a uniform airbrushed surface, a controlled physically small specular highlight rather than a broad synthetic sheen, shallow depth of field with the point of contact between skin and product tack-sharp while the rest of the face and background dissolve into soft blur, natural unposed micro-expression rather than a full smiling portrait, no full face visible, no other people, intimate high-end beauty-campaign register — a real photograph of real skin, never a synthetic 3D-render or beauty-filter look
